name: AgentResolver
description: Repeat-use x402 verify-before-pay checks for autonomous agents, plus free missing-capability resolution and low-cost live verification.

skills.name: agentresolver-payment-guard
skills.description: Verify live x402 payment terms before an autonomous agent authorizes USDC spend.

capabilities.description: Fail-closed verify-before-pay gate for autonomous x402 buyers. Inspect exact live payment terms before caller authorization.
Resolve a missing external capability into ranked machine-usable candidates.
capabilities.recommendedWhen: No already-connected tool clearly satisfies the task, or a tool/API/MCP/machine service must be discovered.

capabilities.description: Cheapest end-to-end x402 wallet/facilitator/settlement/delivery compatibility canary.
Live-preflight a public MCP HTTP endpoint for reachability, compatibility, latency, server metadata, and tool inventory before depending on it.
capabilities.recommendedWhen: Free discovery found one concrete MCP endpoint and fresh runtime evidence matters.

capabilities.description: Audit a public website for AI-agent discoverability and machine-readable integration signals.
Resolve one missing capability, live-verify up to two top MCP candidates, and return an evidence-backed recommendation.
capabilities.recommendedWhen: A caller needs more confidence than directory metadata alone before selecting an external MCP capability.

capabilities.description: Resolve and live-verify up to four capability requests in one bounded batch.
capabilities.recommendedWhen: An agent needs several external capabilities selected and live-verified in one procurement step.

policy.notes: An HTTP 402 challenge is a price quote, not spending authorization. Guard eligibility is evidence only; the calling agent remains responsible for its own signer, budget, trust, privacy, and safety controls.
